author: Kevin Kelly
description: Per-server XP and levels from messages, reactions, voice participation, and Discord slash commands, with configurable curves, leaderboards, announcements, and import/export tools. Use [p]rank and [p]leaderboard, with matching slash commands and /level settings. Adds milestone roles, weekly/monthly/seasonal earned-XP rankings, scoped temporary boosts, configurable farming limits, and a guided setup panel. Includes earned achievement badges, configurable weekly challenges, and themed PNG rank cards. Includes custom achievements with XP/role rewards, bounded activity streaks, automatic monthly seasons and role-filtered rankings.
short: XP, milestone roles, seasonal rankings, boosts, and farming controls.
install_msg: Load with [p]load levelplus, then use [p]level help and [p]level diag. XP sources start enabled. To pause collection, disable message, reaction, and voice XP and set [p]level restrict toggles slashxp false. Review levelplus/README.md for restriction behavior. Enable slash commands as the bot owner with [p]slash enablecog levelplus, then [p]slash sync. New: use [p]level setup, [p]level rewards, [p]level guard, and [p]periodboard. Use [p]achievements, [p]challenges, [p]rankcard, and [p]level challenges enabled true.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild leveling settings, per-user XP totals, and a last-known display name. Data persists across leaves/joins to preserve user progress. Admins may export or erase specific users via commands. Added settings include milestone roles, boosts, farming controls, dated earned-XP totals, seasons, and daily caps; Custom achievement definitions and up to 25 active earned goal IDs per user add qualifying activity counters, last active local date, streak length and pending bonuses bounded at 250000 XP. Automatic monthly seasons retain five top-50 archives and up to five pending top-three winner announcements. Red data hooks export/delete associated user records.
